f3_program: collection("sabrina.cookies", "cookie", "sabrina", source("Sabrina had 20 cookies at the start"))
observe(at("sabrina.cookies.count", "initial"), 20, "count", source("Sabrina had 20 cookies at the start"))
transfer("sabrina_gives_brother", "sabrina", at("sabrina.cookies.count", "current"), at("sabrina.brother.cookies.count", "current"), 10, source("Sabrina gave 10 cookies to her brother"))

transfer("mother_gives_sabrina", "sabrina.mother", at("sabrina.mother.cookies.count", "current"), at("sabrina.cookies.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("sabrina_gives_brother", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("Her mother gave Sabrina half the number of cookies she gave her brother"))

transfer("sabrina_gives_sister", "sabrina", at("sabrina.cookies.count", "current"), at("sabrina.sister.cookies.count", "current"), fraction(at("sabrina.cookies.count", "current"), 2, 3), source("Sabrina gave two-thirds of her cookies to her sister"))
query("remaining_count", "sabrina.cookies", "current")
assumptions: The embedded pronoun "she" refers to Sabrina and therefore to the preceding gift event.

f3_program: observe(at("company.rsus.shares_granted.count", "2019"), 253113, "share", cell("Shares granted", "2019"))
observe(at("company.rsus.shares_granted.count", "2018"), 200000, "share", cell("Shares granted", "2018"))
query("difference", at("company.rsus.shares_granted.count", "2018"), at("company.rsus.shares_granted.count", "2019"))
assumptions: Change is ordered from 2018 to 2019, following the years' order in the question.

f3_program: observe(at("andy.walk.house_to_school.distance", "trip"), 50, "meter", source("50 meters from his house to school"))
same(at("andy.walk.school_to_house.distance", "trip"), at("andy.walk.house_to_school.distance", "trip"), source("comes back to the house"))
observe(at("andy.walk.total_distance", "trip"), 140, "meter", source("he walks 140 meters in total"))

sum_relation(at("andy.walk.total_distance", "trip"), at("andy.walk.house_to_school.distance", "trip"), at("andy.walk.school_to_house.distance", "trip"), at("andy.walk.house_to_market.distance", "trip"), source("After school, he comes back to the house and goes to the market. If he walks 140 meters in total"))
query("value", at("andy.walk.house_to_market.distance", "trip"))
assumptions: Coming back from school to the house denotes the reverse of the stated house-to-school leg.
The stated total covers the house-to-school, school-to-house, and house-to-market legs.

f3_program: collection("bell_media.operating_revenues.requested_periods", "period_operating_revenue", "bell_media", source("Bell Media operating revenues increased by 3.4%"))
observe(at("bell_media.operating_revenues.q4_2019", "Q4 2019"), 879, "currency", cell("Bell Media", "Q4 2019"))
observe(at("bell_media.operating_revenues.q4_2018", "Q4 2018"), 850, "currency", cell("Bell Media", "Q4 2018"))
member("bell_media.operating_revenues.requested_periods", "bell_media.operating_revenues.q4_2019", cell("Bell Media", "Q4 2019"))
member("bell_media.operating_revenues.requested_periods", "bell_media.operating_revenues.q4_2018", cell("Bell Media", "Q4 2018"))
query("sum", "bell_media.operating_revenues.requested_periods", "current")
assumptions: The table amounts are represented as generic currency because the supplied table does not state a denomination scale.

f3_program: collection("john.doors_to_replace", "door", "john", source("John has 3 bedroom doors and two outside doors to replace"))
observe(at("john.doors_to_replace.bedroom.count", "replacement"), 3, "count", source("3 bedroom doors"))
observe(at("john.doors_to_replace.outside.count", "replacement"), 2, "count", source("two outside doors"))
collection("john.doors_to_replace.replacement_costs", "door_replacement_cost", "john.doors_to_replace", source("The outside doors cost $20 each to replace and the bedroom doors are half that cost"))
observe(at("john.doors_to_replace.outside.replacement_cost_per_door", "replacement"), 20, "currency", source("outside doors cost $20 each to replace"))

fraction_of(at("john.doors_to_replace.bedroom.replacement_cost_per_door", "replacement"), at("john.doors_to_replace.outside.replacement_cost_per_door", "replacement"), 1, 2, source("bedroom doors are half that cost"))
query("sum", "john.doors_to_replace.replacement_costs", "replacement")
assumptions: The requested total is the sum of one replacement-cost entry for every described door.
